title: Allison Quinn joins Morehead State women's basketball staff as assistant coach
text:
Allison Quinn has joined the Morehead State women’s basketball staff as an assistant for the 2026-27 season, according to a June 17 announcement from the university.
Quinn comes to Morehead State after serving two seasons as a Graduate Assistant at Division II Wingate University in North Carolina, where she earned her master’s in sport management. Before that, she spent three seasons as a manager with North Carolina State University’s women’s basketball program.
During her time at NC State, the Wolfpack advanced to the Women’s Final Four in 2024 and were Atlantic Coast Conference champions in 2022, reaching the Elite Eight of the NCAA Tournament that year. Quinn received her Bachelor of Science in sport management from NC State in 2024.
Morehead State head coach Jackie Alexander said, “Allie’s high-energy approach, strong work ethic, and passion for connecting with others make her a tremendous addition to our staff. As a relationship builder and culture driver, she will play a vital role in elevating our program both on and off the court.”
Quinn played three seasons of varsity basketball at Western Alamance High School in Elon, North Carolina. She was also a three-sport athlete during high school.
“I am incredibly grateful and honored for the opportunity to join the Morehead State Women’s Basketball program,” said Quinn. “I look forward to working alongside our student-athletes and coaching staff to build a program that competes at the highest level. I am thrilled to be joining Eagle Nation and can’t wait for what lies ahead!”
